scenes.say: Imagine this. You live in Texas, with some of the best sun in the country.
But there's no statewide net metering.
In most of Texas, your retail electricity plan's solar buyback rate decides what your exported power is worth.
With a plan that credits exports near retail, a typical system pays back in about ten years.
With a low buyback rate, it can take fifteen years or more.
The good news: there's a one hundred percent property tax exemption on solar, statewide.
Going solar in Texas? Read the free guide at viva voltia dot com.
